name: Leader 1:1 Bot
description: Produces the groundwork managers usually scramble for: agendas for weekly one-to-ones, written feedback drafts, and a briefing to read before the day starts. Built around a regular management cadence, so it earns its place if you hold those meetings consistently and rather less if you don't.

official.title: Leader 1:1 bot by Scott
official.description: Prep coaching — Weekly 1:1, feedback drafts, manager morning briefing.
